adjudication.rationale: In spec/components/topic_retriever_spec.rb (valid-host context), the tests explicitly stub retrieved_recently? to return true/false and set expectations on perform_retrieve (once/never). This means the suite does not execute TopicRetriever’s real throttle logic (the $redis.setnx/expire path in retrieved_recently?), nor any of perform_retrieve’s branches (existing-embed bailout, optional Jobs::PollFeed trigger, or fetch_http user lookup/import). As a result, regressions in those newly added behaviors could go undetected while tests still pass.
